context: Asuka lectures on the basics of measurement.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: science lecture; vocabulary (含む/単位/基づい/主体/想定) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 測定は、正しい単位に基づいて行います。
lines.en: Measurement is done based on correct units.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 単位には、何が含まれますか?
lines.style: attentive adult student voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 長さや重さを、含む基準です。
lines.en: It's a standard that includes length and weight.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 実験では、何が主体になりますか?
lines.en: What becomes the main focus in experiments?
lines.style: curious adult student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 観察を主体に、進めます。
lines.en: We proceed with observation as the main focus.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 結果は、想定どおりになりますか?
lines.en: Do results come out as expected?
lines.style: thoughtful adult student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 想定を超えることも、よくあります。
lines.en: Going beyond expectations is common too.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 単位に基づく考え方、分かりました。
lines.en: I understand the unit-based way of thinking.
lines.style: satisfied adult student voice, soft warm realization throughout
